title: refactor(app-shell,console): Create View, the Excel import bar and the API console pick with the shared Select (objectui#11865)
body:
Part of #11865

Clause-②: no

Slice n of claim `6071773793`: the three single native select elements left in the shell and the console become the shared Radix `Select` (`packages/components/src/ui/select`, used, not edited), following the card's eight landed slices (objectui#11976 through objectui#12013). This PR converts these files and no others:

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/CreateViewDialog.tsx`: every config pick a view type asks for (kanban's group-by field, the date and title fields, gallery's cover, map's coordinates, tree's parent, and the chart's type, dataset, measure and dimension), through one module-private `ConfigPicker`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ExcelImportBar.tsx`: the object to import into, through a module-private `ObjectPicker`.
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.tsx`: the HTTP method, through a module-private `MethodPicker`.

Run by the os-dev agent for seat `domain:ui#2`, branch `claude/issue-11865-shell-singles-select`.

## What changed

- Each picker is the card's established shape (`CreatePicker`, `OwdPicker`, `LanguagePicker`): items carry their option's index, so the Create View placeholder, whose value is the empty string, needs no empty `SelectItem`, and a held value none of the options carries gets an item of its own, labelled with the value. Picking that item writes nothing. No picker is exported.
- Each picker calls the handler the native `onChange` called with the same string: `choose(rf, value)` in Create View, `setSelected` in the import bar, `setMethodOverride` in the API console. No write path moved.
- `CreateViewDialog`: the trigger carries the row's `id` (so the row's label element still names it through `htmlFor`), its test id, and `aria-required` for a required pick. Its `disabled` (nothing to offer, or the catalog or the chosen dataset's members still loading) is the primitive's.
- `ExcelImportBar`: disabled while the object list is empty or loading, as before. The trigger is `w-auto`, so it keeps its place in the bar's wrapping row.
- `ApiConsolePage`: the trigger keeps the verb colours (`METHOD_COLORS`) the native control wore.
- `packages/components/src/ui/**`, `packages/i18n/**`, every export and every prop are unchanged. No i18n key is added.

## Select, not Combobox

- The chart type (5), the dataset and its members, the date, title, cover, coordinate and parent fields, the five HTTP verbs and the import targets are the kinds of list the card's earlier slices put on `Select`: the validation editor's field picker and *Explain access*'s object picker (24 objects) both use it.
- `Combobox` would change a write: its `onSelect` passes an empty string when the current option is picked again (`currentValue === value ? "" : currentValue` in `packages/components/src/custom/combobox.tsx`). Re-picking the held field would then clear the pick, where the native control wrote nothing.

## Hypotheses, measured

**H1, value parity: holds.** A scratch probe (never committed) on base `5d77c099b`, in a separate detached worktree, drove each native control with a `change` event and pressed Create, Import or Send. The new pins compare against those readings as JSON text.
- Create View: 61 rows. Every option of every pick of every type (kanban, calendar, timeline, gantt, gallery, map, tree; the chart's type, dataset, measure and dimension, with the binding a member pick needs picked first) leads to the same `onCreate` payload. The placeholder still clears the pick and leaves Create disabled. Choosing another dataset still clears the measure (and the dimension) picked from the previous one.
- One reading differs by construction: re-picking the dataset already held. The probe forced a `change` for it, which clears the measure. A browser fires no `change` for the option already selected, and the primitive calls no `onValueChange` for it, so the measure stays. That case is pinned on its own.
- Excel import bar: each of the 3 listed objects imports into itself (`getObjectSchema` and the wizard's `objectName` / `objectLabel`); a `defaultObjectName` the list carries is the starting pick, as before.
- API console: each of the 5 verbs sends the same `fetch` call, with and without a body typed under POST first. The body still rides only on POST, PATCH and PUT. No pick still sends GET, and a request preset's verb is still the one sent.

**H2, names, keyboard and disabled: holds.**
- Names, read on base with `getByRole('combobox', { name })`: each Create View pick is named by its row's label (`htmlFor`) and carries `aria-required="true"`. The trigger keeps both. The import bar's picker and the API console's selector had no label, `id` or `aria-label`, so their names were empty, and are still empty (kept for parity; see Acceptance notes). The name pins are green on base and head by design.
- Keyboard: Enter opens and Enter on an option selects, pinned once per surface.
- Disabled: Create View's measure picker before a dataset is chosen, and a group-by pick on an object with nothing to group by, are the primitive's disabled trigger (`data-disabled`), and the keyboard does not open them. The import bar with no object to list is the same. The API console has no disabled or read-only state for its selector.

**H3, a held value no option carries: holds, and was misleading on base.** Base readings:
- Create View, a group-by field the object no longer has (the object definition re-rendered without it): the native control showed the placeholder, while Create wrote `stage`. Head shows `stage`, and Create still writes it.
- Import bar, a `defaultObjectName` the list does not return: the native control showed "Account", while Import loaded into `ghost`. Head shows `ghost`.
- Import bar, a failed object list with a `defaultObjectName`: the native control was disabled and blank, while Import stayed enabled and loaded into `crm_deal`. Head shows `crm_deal` on the disabled trigger.
- API console: every source of the method is typed `HttpMethod`, the five verbs the selector lists, so no held value outside them reaches the page. The picker keeps the pattern's outside item all the same.

**H4, first-load bytes: +263 B gzip, under the 1,024 B stop line.** `apps/console`, `CI=true pnpm exec vite build`, under the lock:
- Base `5d77c099b`: `eagerGzipBytes` 3,235,851, `eagerRawBytes` 10,889,025, 289 eager of 2,474 chunks.
- Head `ef6adb98f` (later commits change test files only): `eagerGzipBytes` 3,236,114, `eagerRawBytes` 10,889,585, 289 of 2,474. Delta +263 B gzip, +560 B raw.
- Where it lands: `CreateViewDialog-*.js` (eager) +155 B gzip; `studioScope-*.js` (eager; it carries `ExcelImportBar`) +109 B; the entry chunk -1 B (renamed lazy chunk hashes). `ApiConsolePage-*.js` is lazy. `ui-components` and `vendor-radix` keep their file names, so the shared `Select` was already eager.
- `pnpm check:eager-closure` on the head build: "Console eager closure is 3160.3 KB gzipped across 289 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 44.3 KB)". On the base build: 3160.0 KB, headroom 44.5 KB.

## Tests

New pins:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/CreateViewDialog.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` (85 tests)
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/ExcelImportBar.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` (11 tests)
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` (17 tests)

Suites that drove the native selects now pick through the primitive. Their harness changed, their assertions keep their meaning:
- `CreateViewDialog.chartBinding-11576` and `CreateViewDialog.viewTypeParse-11581`: pick by the option's label, and read the options a picker lists as labels instead of values (for example `Deal metrics (deal_metrics)` for the dataset).
- `ObjectView.createChartView-11576` and `ObjectView.createKanbanView-11581` (they mount `CreateViewDialog` through `ObjectView`): the same helpers.
- `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591`: the method field's value is read as the trigger's text.

Reverse leg, from committed head `4a2a9bee3`: the three source files were put back on their base blobs (`aa96b493`, `f6944c0c`, `54b9efdd`; hash-checked on disk, one native select and no picker in each) and the three new pins run: `Tests 106 failed | 7 passed (113)`. The 7 passing are green on both sides by design: the 5 name pins, the API console's literal control and its no-pick case. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`: the on-disk blobs equal HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes. A trap restored on EXIT, INT and TERM. The first reverse leg, at `ae84c4e74`, read `101 failed | 12 passed`. 5 of those 12 passed on the native control only because its disabled state, or its text (every option's text, so a substring check matched), satisfied them; `4a2a9bee3` makes them read the primitive (`data-disabled`, the trigger's exact text).

## Gates

Head `754392971` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` after the last commit), worktree clean.
- Repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run` (lock slot `issue-11865n`) on `754392971`: the 3 new pins, `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591`, `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 143 passed (143)`.
- On `4a2a9bee3` (the source files and these suites are identical on `754392971`): the 3 pins, the 5 adapted suites and both ratchets: `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 175 passed (175)`.
- On `ef6adb98f` (the source files are identical on `754392971`; only the 3 pins changed since): every suite that mounts the three components, 109 files. That is the `ObjectView.*`, `ObjectDataPage.*` and `CreateViewDialog.*` suites in `packages/app-shell/src/views`, `InterfaceListPage.treeChartRelay-11572`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.viewItemSpec`, every suite in `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__` (the `AiChatPage` suites), the `ApiConsolePage` suites, `ToolPreview.test.tsx`, and both ratchets: `Test Files 109 passed (109)`, `Tests 1005 passed (1005)`.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 34 successful, 34 total`. Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0 on `4a2a9bee3` (app-shell's files are identical on `754392971`); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` exits 0 on `754392971`. `tsc --listFilesOnly` lists every touched file: the console program, app-shell's main program, and app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` for its tests.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 11 touched ts and tsx files (count read from `--format json`): 0 errors, 34 warnings, each file at its base blob's count (base 34; read with `--stdin`). The 3 new pins carry none. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`).
- Each exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ("11 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `pnpm check:control-bytes`.
- Derived by hand from objectui's `package.json` and the touched paths, each exit 0: `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` (it refused the first form of two pin mocks; both now spread `importOriginal`), `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:shell-escape-residue`.

Changeset: `.changeset/11865-n-shell-console-shared-select.md`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` and `'@object-ui/console': patch`.

Docs: no guide or README describes these controls. A `git grep` of `content/docs` and both packages' READMEs for the component names and the surfaces' labels finds nothing, so no doc change.

## Acceptance notes

None of these is filed. Each is noted with no carrier.
- The import bar's object picker and the API console's method selector have no accessible name, before and after: no label, `id` or `aria-label` is associated with either. Kept for parity, as the claim asks. Naming them is a separate change.
- Create View keeps a held field pick that the object no longer has (a `field`-kind pick is not re-checked against the options, unlike the dataset, measure and dimension picks), so Create writes it. Before and after alike; the trigger now shows it instead of the placeholder. Reaching it needs the object definition to change while the dialog is open.
- The import bar imports into a `defaultObjectName` the object list does not return, or into it while the list has failed. Before and after alike; the trigger now shows that name.
